article.headline: Luis Suarez strikes late as Inter Miami edges past D.C. United 1-0
article.summary: Luis Suarez scored the decisive goal to secure a 1-0 victory for Inter Miami over D.C. United in Major League Soccer.
article.body:
Luis Suarez secured the win for Inter Miami by finding the back of the net in a tight contest against D.C. United. The solitary goal proved to be the difference maker in a match defined by defensive resolve and a singular moment of attacking clinicality from the former Barcelona star. 

This victory holds significant weight for Inter Miami as the club continues its pursuit of points in the Major League Soccer standings. Securing a clean sheet alongside the late goal allows the team to maintain momentum and solidify its position in the league rankings against a competitive conference opponent like D.C. United. 

According to OneFootball, the match concluded with a 1-0 scoreline in favor of Inter Miami. The BBC sports data confirms that the fixture featured standard Major League Soccer statistics and head-to-head analysis, highlighting the narrow margin of victory required to overcome the visiting side. 

Inter Miami will look to carry this winning form into their upcoming schedule as the Major League Soccer season progresses. The club continues to rely on their experienced core to navigate these close encounters effectively.

article.headline: Max Verstappen Clenches Maiden Singapore Grand Prix Pole Position at Marina Bay
article.summary: Max Verstappen qualified first for the Singapore Grand Prix, narrowly beating Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc at the Marina Bay Street Circuit.
article.body: Max Verstappen clinched pole position at the Marina Bay Street Circuit for the first time in his career, clocking a lap of 1m 31.373s. This performance secured him the top spot for the Singapore Grand Prix, effectively pushing Ferrari’s Charles Leclerc into second place by a margin of only 0.054s. Lewis Hamilton took third position after the qualifying hour, having led the pace during the initial segments of the session. The result follows a volatile weekend that included a rain-hit sprint race featuring a record nine retirements. Verstappen’s latest success at the circuit comes after he also claimed victory in the 20-lap sprint event held on Oct 10. The qualifying hour saw varying performances from the field, as drivers navigated the drying Marina Bay streets following earlier rain. Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc lead the immediate chasing pack, while George Russell finished in P6, though he carries an incoming grid penalty into the main race. Further down the order, Isack Hadjar faced significant reliability issues with his Red Bull, finishing the session at the bottom. Meanwhile, drivers like Fernando Alonso and the Cadillac pair of Sergio Perez and Valtteri Bottas failed to advance through the grid in a highly competitive qualifying session. With the starting order largely finalized, attention now shifts to the main Singapore Grand Prix event. The grid positions will be adjusted to account for existing penalties, such as the one applied to George Russell, which will see those ranked behind him move up a place. Teams are now preparing for the main race, looking to capitalize on positions earned during this qualifying hour on the Marina Bay layout.

news.og_title: بيئي / الدفاع المدني يدعو إلى أخذ الحيطة والحذر مع استمرار هطول الأمطار الرعدية على معظم مناطق المملكة حتى يوم الأربعاء المقبل
news.og_desc:
الرياض 29 ربيع الآخر 1448 هـ الموافق 10 أكتوبر 2026 م واس
    دعت المديرية العامة للدفاع المدني إلى أخذ الحيطة والحذر، وضرورة البقاء في أماكن آمنة والابتعاد عن أماكن تجمُّع السيول والأودية وعدم السباحة فيها، والالتزام بالتعليمات المعلنة عبر وسائل الإعلام المختلفة ومواقع التواصل الاجتماعي، وذلك لاستمرار هطول الأمطار الرعدية على معظم مناطق المملكة، حتى يوم الأربعاء المقبل.
    وكان مركز الأرصاد قد أوضح أن منطقة مكة المكرمة، ستتأثر بأمطار من متوسطة إلى غزيرة تؤدي إلى جريان السيول وتساقط البرد ورياح هابطة مثيرة للأتربة والغبار، تشمل العاصمة المقدسة والكامل والجموم وبحرة والطائف وميسان وأضم والعرضيات، وخفيفة إلى متوسطة لتشمل الليث والقنفذة وجدة ورابغ وخليص ورنية والخرمة والمويه وتربة.
    وأشار إلى أن مناطق جازان وعسير والباحة وتبوك والجوف والحدود الشمالية ستتأثر بأمطار من متوسطة إلى غزيرة تؤدي إلى جريان السيول وتساقط البرد ورياح هابطة مثيرة للأتربة والغبار وخفيفة إلى متوسطة على مناطق المدينة المنورة وحائل ونجران.
